text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 4, "unit": "rows", "kind": "count", "span": "4 rows of seats"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 18, "unit": "seats", "kind": "count", "span": "18 seats in each row"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "One-fourth of the seats"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "One-third of the remaining seats"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "total seats: rows times seats per row"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "seats occupied by the administrators (one-fourth)"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "remaining seats after the administrators"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "seats occupied by the parents (one-third of the remainder)"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "the rest, occupied by the students"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many students were in the school auditorium"}, "dismissed": []}
